transactions.prompt: Recheck the active tool registry for DIRECT Desktop Commander now, fresh in this response. Do not substitute Remote Desktop Commander. If direct Desktop Commander is absent, answer exactly BLOCKED_DIRECT_DESKTOP_COMMANDER. If present, immediately call its fresh health/config primitive and return a compact PASS receipt naming the direct tool and canonical Windows host.

Given host preflight=${ai.host-preflight}, own the next transaction. If it is BLOCKED_DIRECT_DESKTOP_COMMANDER, do not use any substitute and answer exactly BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED. Otherwise, through DIRECT Desktop Commander inspect E:\android\platform-tools\adb.exe, run that exact adb.exe version and adb.exe devices -l, and return ADB_PATH, VERSION, and exact device rows. Require exactly one row in state device; otherwise answer BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED with observed count/state.

Given adb preflight=${ai.adb-preflight}, continue only if exactly one authorized device is proven. Locate/materialize the exact accepted diagnostic APK for source commit e752d15c8c796564e17f93d01b66c81adb99e9ed with required SHA-256 bfdc67492b960be0f5860b2ce9228f7112337f20437ce3c0442c0e4e4809b85e. Verify bytes and SHA-256 before any install. Return the canonical Windows APK path plus verified hash/size. If this cannot be proven, answer BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED and do not install.

Given ADB=${ai.adb-preflight} and APK=${ai.accepted-apk}, continue only when both are proven. Through DIRECT Desktop Commander run ci\device-acceptance\run-adb-acceptance.ps1 with the exact APK path, mandatory -ExpectedSha256 bfdc67492b960be0f5860b2ce9228f7112337f20437ce3c0442c0e4e4809b85e, and explicit -ConfirmInstall. Do NOT pass -EnableAccessibilityViaAdb unless owner/developer secure-setting authority is explicitly proven; otherwise allow the harness to emit its BLOCKED receipt and open Accessibility Settings. Return the exact SELF_NUDGE_ADB_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE/1 status/boundary and evidence path. On any command exception, inspect it and return an AI_DEBUG_COMMAND repair rather than abandoning the transaction.

Given base physical acceptance=${ai.base-device-acceptance}, run the same exact accepted APK/device harness with -RunChatGptProbe only if base status is PASS. Require installed com.openai.chatgpt, APPLIED, and ACCESSIBILITY AUTOMATION WORKS. If base is blocked/fail, preserve that state and answer BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED. Return exact receipt boundary/evidence.

Given ChatGPT acceptance=${ai.chatgpt-device-acceptance}, run the harness with -RunChatGptProbe -RunUnknownOutcomeCase only if ChatGPT acceptance is PASS. Accept only if the app mechanically records UNKNOWN_OUTCOME after induced target interruption. Otherwise preserve the exact blocked/fail state. Return receipt boundary/evidence.

Audit the final device evidence implied by base=${ai.base-device-acceptance}, chatgpt=${ai.chatgpt-device-acceptance}, unknown=${ai.unknown-outcome-acceptance}. Inspect JSON receipt, threadtime logcat and relevant UIAutomator XML through DIRECT Desktop Commander when available. Do not promote CI evidence to device evidence. Return either PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTED with exact receipt path and key gates, or BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED with the single exact unresolved boundary.
